title: Quantitative eigenvector universality for generalized Wigner matrices
summary: We present a novel approach to eigenvector universality for generalized Wigner matrices. Our main consequences are asymptotic normality of joint eigenvector projections everywhere in the spectrum as well as, under a uniform subexponential decay assumption, convergence of the extremal process of eigenvector entries and the resulting Gumbel law for the largest entry of an eigenvector. In the case of smooth entries, we are able to obtain joint normality of an explicit growing number of eigenvector projections, and we are also able to obtain explicit rates of convergence in Kolmogorov distance,…
